name: ButtonGroup
intro: Place ButtonGroup.Button parts inside Root. The root supplies shared Button styling defaults.

props.name: segmented
props.description: Joins the buttons into one visual segment.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default color treatment for child buttons.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Default text-link treatment for child buttons.

parts.name: Button
parts.description: Uses Button styling and can override the root variant, size, or unstyled setting.

accessibility: Choose labels that distinguish each action. The root supplies the group role; add an accessible group name when the relationship needs one.
